name: Aiven MCP
description:
Manage your Aiven cloud data platform in plain language. The Aiven MCP connects Claude to your fully managed PostgreSQL, Apache Kafka, and application infrastructure, so you can provision, query, and operate services through conversation instead of the console or CLI.

Managed PostgreSQL:
Provision and configure Postgres services, run read and write SQL, manage PgBouncer connection pooling, inspect pg_stat query statistics, and tune slow queries with AI-powered query optimization.

Apache Kafka & streaming:
Create and manage topics, produce and consume messages, set up Kafka Connect source and sink connectors, and browse Schema Registry subjects, full event-streaming workflows from a chat.

Application deployment:
Deploy your Dockerized apps to Aiven directly from your connected GitHub repositories, and rebuild or redeploy in a single request.

Observability & operations:
Fetch service and application metrics, stream service logs, view live query activity and project event logs, and power services on or off across your projects, clouds, and VPCs.

Documentation search:
Query the official Aiven documentation in natural language, without leaving Claude.

Built for safe, scoped access:
  - Read-only mode exposes only non-destructive tools.
  - Service scoping limits the toolset to PostgreSQL, Kafka, applications, or integrations.
  - Connection credentials are redacted by default.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Aiven MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Aiven MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.aiven.live/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Aiven MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Aiven MCP lists 52 MCP tools, including aiven_application_deploy, aiven_application_redeploy, aiven_integration_endpoint_types_list, aiven_integration_types_list, aiven_kafka_connect_available_connectors, aiven_kafka_connect_create_connector, aiven_kafka_connect_delete_connector, aiven_kafka_connect_edit_connector, aiven_kafka_connect_get_connector_status, aiven_kafka_connect_list, aiven_kafka_connect_pause_connector, and aiven_kafka_connect_restart_connector.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Aiven MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Aiven MCP in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Aiven MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Aiven MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Aiven MCP is developed by Aiven. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
